messages:
carla: quick heads-up: after the 2.4.1 SDKs landed a handful of customers reported quota being charged to the wrong pool. traces show route=low-latency but billing points to cost-saver pool.

diego: can you paste a minimal repro request/headers? suspect either header name change or a new telemetry field.

carla: repro curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \
  -H 'X-Route-Hint: low-latency' \
  -H 'X-SDK-Dev-Mode: true' \
  -d '{"input":"status"}'
```

nora: replayed span id s-e99. Gateway received X-SDK-Dev-Mode and our routing heuristic treats unknown SDK flags as opt-in to cost-saving experiments. that was supposed to be internal-only.

sam: ah, the convenience dev-mode in ts/py accidentally shipped enabled by default in the bundler. that explains it.

carla: console shows correct routehint in trace metadata but routed_pool mismatch. we should avoid coupling telemetry/default sdk flags with routing logic.

diego: short-term plan: (1) ship a tiny SDK patch to disable X-SDK-Dev-Mode by default (py/ts) (2) update router to ignore unknown X-SDK-* headers for routing decisions unless tenant flag is set, emit metric routing.ignored_sdk_flag_count (3) add console dashboard tile to expose routehint vs charged_pool mismatches by tenant and a small alert.

nora: I can do the router change and add the metric. will canary it to ap-south first.

sam: I will cut the TS patch and the release note clarifying default dev flags. carla can you do python?

carla: on it. also adding to our release notes a short troubleshooting blurb so support can explain.

ops-bot: Deploy started: router-ignore-sdkflags -> canary (3 instances) by nora at 6190000100

diego: longer-term: add an integration test that runs client->gateway->router and asserts tenant pins take precedence over any client flags; update docs to state which headers are honored for routing.

carla: summary: revert dev-mode default in SDKs; router ignore unknown SDK headers for routing unless tenant opt-in; metric + console tile; monitor 48h. tagging @diego @nora @sam
